versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the washing machine buying consultant skill.
- Guides users step-by-step through questions on household size, laundry habits, installation space, utilities, and feature priorities.
- Analyzes user input to recommend a precise washing machine specification—covering capacity, spin speed, efficiency, water connection, and more—without brand or marketing bias.
- Provides region-aware guidance based on power, water standards, and local requirements.
- Designed for new buyers or those upgrading, aiming to ensure confident, informed washing machine purchases.
